name: rx-dropzone
title: Dropzone (React)
description: Drop target for files built on react-dropzone - drag files in or activate the area (click, Enter, Space) to open the picker, with accept, size and count validation. Parts: Dropzone + icon + title + description + action. State in data-drag-active, data-drag-reject, data-disabled, data-invalid.

usage.whenToUse: TBD - document when to use rx-dropzone.
usage.whenNotToUse: TBD - document when to reach for something else.
